title: Clean a shop's till export into a workbook that adds up
person: The bookkeeper of a two-shop flower business tidying a till export before the month's VAT return.
review: Every amount is a number, the closed day is blank with a note saying why, and the totals are 6,110 for Storgatan and 7,640 for Nygatan, 13,750 in all.
revised_review: The corrected 3 September figure for the Nygatan shop is 2,940, so Nygatan totals 8,030 and both shops 14,140.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
No hidden rows, columns or sheets.
Every column of the table has one unique heading.
Every value in a column of numbers is stored as a number.
The closed day is a blank cell with a note saying Storgatan was closed on 2 September, not a dash or a zero.

source: Synthetic material created for this evaluation pack; the people, clubs, shops and numbers are invented.
stage_policy: Separate first and revision directories; reveal revision only after first output is frozen.
